lines.text: Many learners say: I eat medicine at night.
Better: I take medicine at night.
Take! You must take medicine now.

native.tip: Kita bilang “makan obat”, tapi bahasa Inggris pakai take medicine.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I eat medicine at night.” 😅 Untuk obat, pakai take: “I take medicine at night.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “take”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I take medicine at night.” Lalu ganti night dengan morning. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “makan obat”, but English uses take medicine.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I eat medicine at night.” 😅 For medicine, use take: “I take medicine at night.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
